items.title: Missed Illumina's 76% Run? Here Is What Holders Saw
items.summary: If Illumina sat on your watchlist instead of in your portfolio, the past year might feel like a missed shot. Investors who held Illumina over the past year are up 76.2%, including dividends. That outcome arrived alongside headlines about NovaSeq X uptake, clinical sequencing demand, and moves into multiomics.
